mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates signal accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment rates indicate strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 850,000 units annually signal robust residential demand, triggering economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.0% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate below 0.5% and unemployment decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points indicates coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market improvement
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE decline > 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent month-over-month increases in housing starts and industrial production exceeding 0.5% signal broad-based economic strength, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST mom > 0.5 and INDPRO mom > 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, retail sales growth above the 12-month moving average indicates strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-recession recovery when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: During high-growth economic regimes, industrial production above its 6-month moving average signals robust manufacturing activity, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during high-growth economic regimes when INDPRO exceeds its 6-month moving average.
